subject: Remove redundant has_text_predicate field (#734)
reason: Pure refactor with no reachable behaviour change. The removed has_text_predicate boolean was set only at the end of FilterParser::ParseTextTokens, the exact function whose every successful exit already sets QueryOperations::kContainsText (filter_parser.cc:874,882), so the new QueryHasTextPredicate derivation (search.cc:766) returns the identical value for every parseable query: replies, metrics and the main-thread retry gating are bit-identical on the local FT.SEARCH path. The other deleted code, recomputing the flag in the gRPC deserializer (search_converter.cc), is replaced by the query_oper
